skill.description: Use SAM for zero-shot image segmentation with points, boxes, or masks.

memory.responsibility: Retain source image plus decisions, observations, and verification evidence needed to resume safely.

planning.responsibility: Transform point box or mask prompt into the ordered, bounded stages defined by this skill.

action.responsibility: Advance the workflow through sam image encoder while preserving stop conditions and user authority.

capability.responsibility: Expose only the production and rendering capabilities needed for the requested artifact and format.

stages: Load and normalize the source image
Choose positive points boxes or prior mask
Export mask cutout and overlay preview

maturity.claim_boundary: This repository validates and plans the harness contract; it does not claim live service execution or benchmark gains without a connected adapter and measured evidence.
